name: AI Humanizer
description: Free online writing tool that makes rough AI-assisted drafts clearer, more natural, and easier to make your own. English and Simplified Chinese. No signup. Six prompt modes, one of which is heuristic text self-review, processed in the cloud by DeepSeek Chat (deepseek-chat). 100% free. No detector-score claims.

tools.name: AI Humanizer
tools.long_description: Submits the text to DeepSeek Chat with a prompt asking for varied sentence length, conversational transitions and plainer wording. The prompt asks the model to preserve citations, numbers and proper nouns; verify manually — LLM output is not post-processed, and exact preservation is not guaranteed. Processing happens in DeepSeek's cloud, not locally. No registration and no payment.
tools.rate_limit: 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window

tools.name: Essay Writing Improvement
tools.long_description: Uses an essay-specific prompt asking DeepSeek to preserve the thesis, argument structure, citations, dates, numbers and proper nouns while rewriting surface expression in a more natural student-like voice. The prompt asks the model to preserve citations, numbers and proper nouns; verify manually — LLM output is not post-processed, and exact preservation is not guaranteed. No detector-specific tuning.
tools.rate_limit: 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window

tools.name: Turnitin Writing Guidance
tools.long_description: A DeepSeek prompt favoring conversational phrasing, varied paragraph lengths and natural replacements for templated vocabulary. Turnitin is not queried and no detector outcome is promised. Users are responsible for their institution's academic-integrity rules.
tools.rate_limit: 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window

tools.name: Walter Writes Style Rewriter
tools.long_description: Asks DeepSeek to rewrite text with short paragraphs, conversational transitions, parenthetical asides and direct opinions. This is a style-imitation prompt, not a claim about any detector's internal signals.
tools.rate_limit: 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window

tools.name: AI Text Self-review
tools.long_description: Asks DeepSeek Chat to output strict JSON: ai_probability, human_probability, verdict, five requested signals and explanation. No third-party detector API is called; signals are prompt-generated, not independently computed, weighted or calibrated against detector feedback. Not a detector verdict and cannot validate authorship.
tools.rate_limit: 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window

tools.name: Chinese Writing Improvement
tools.long_description: A zh-CN prompt asking DeepSeek to replace stock phrases such as 赋能, 抓手 and 底层逻辑 with plainer Chinese prose while keeping the argument, citations and data. The prompt asks the model to preserve citations, numbers and proper nouns; verify manually — LLM output is not post-processed, and exact preservation is not guaranteed. No Chinese detector service is queried.
tools.rate_limit: 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window

detection_observations.statement_en: An earlier, undocumented internal impression suggested roughly 85–95%, but it has been withdrawn: a published self-check pilot on 2026-11-24 measured 13.3% (4/30) with this site’s own detector. The two are not comparable; third-party spot-checks remain incomplete and returned 100% AI on rewrites. These figures are published as evidence of limits, not as a product claim.
